messages:
leo: quick note  proposing a "soft-enqueue bridge" idea to reduce 429s during short spikes. frontdoor can return an enqueue-handle (202) instead of hard reject; backend workers drain a lower-priority lane.

amara: sounds promising. we need: signed handles (HMAC), per-tenant enqueue caps, and enqueue cost charged at accept.

leo: handle TTL 3-6s default, tunable per-route. SDK should auto-poll w/ jitter and expose in_progress state.

tj: fairness concern: queued items must respect tenant weights. recommend weighted-round-robin with per-priority reservoirs as fallback.

amara: security notes: include nonce + sig to prevent replay, and include route/version to avoid stale promotions.

deploy-bot: deploy plan: dry-run emitting telemetry (enqueue_rate, expiry_rate, dequeue_lat) while still returning 429s; then gradual flip per-region.

leo: edge notes: shard queues by edge node to avoid cross-node sync costs; allow overflow to cross-region queue. workers claim -> lease_id -> complete/abort. on lease expiry re-enqueue with capped retries.

tj: ops: dashboards for per-tenant enqueue spend, >3% expiry alert, anomaly detector for single-client enqueue storms. also perf targets: <1% impact on fast-path p50.

amara: will draft RFC with proto example and SDK sketch. pinging @tj for perf harness help.
